RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, August 1, 2011/Sravana 10, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Corporate
Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Mines; Minority Affairs;
New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary Affairs; Power;
Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Food Security Bill
*1. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Empowered Group of
Ministers (EGoM) has recently cleared a
rationalised version of the Food Security
Bill after amending some of the provisions
suggested by the National Advisory
Council (NAC);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has now
agreed to provide legal entitlements of
cheap foodgrains to APL households,
despite objections by an expert panel
appointed by the Prime Minister; and
(d) if so, the details of the corrective
measures now Government proposes to
take to insert the views of the expert
panel?
Shortage of storage capacity for
foodgrains
*2. DR. K.V.P. RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the existing
storage capacity across the country is
brimming with foodgrains with no further
space for storage of more foodgrains;
(b) if so, how the rabi season grains are
proposed to be stored; and
(c) to what extent the recent decision
to export rice would ease the shortage of
storage capacity?
Availability of sugar
†*3. SHRI RA VI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a stock of 29
million tonnes of sugar, including

2
remaining stock of last year and the current
year's production, was available in the
country during the sugar year 2010-11;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that during
the first nine months of the year,
23-24 million tonnes of sugar has already
been sold i.e. till the month of June, by way
of export and allocation for domestic
consumption;
(d) if so, the quantity of sugar that
would be required for consumption during
the remaining three months of the year
which are considered as festival months;
and
(e) the remaining stock of sugar in the
country that would be available as on 30th
September, 2011?
Food inflation
*4. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the rate of
inflation in food items, including
vegetables is rising sharply, causing great
difficulties to common people;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is considering
to take any step to bring down this food
inflation;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether this inflation is linked with
the recent hike of petrol prices along with
the hike in prices of other petro-products;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Impact of earthquake and tsunami in
Japan on Indian sea waters
*5. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the recent earthquake and
tsunami in Japan has had any impact on
the sea waters bordering India;
(b) whether Government has noticed the
increasing number of death of sea whales,
sharks and other big creatures in the Indian
sea waters;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, whether Government would
initiate action to study these effects?
Addition in power generation capacity
†*6. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been any increase
in power generation capacity in the country
during the last three years;
(b) if so, the details of the capacity
addition in megawatts, plant-wise and
State-wise;
(c) whether more new power plants are
likely to be commissioned during the
current financial year; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Reduction in power generation cost
*7. SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has set up a
designated task force to explore
possibilities for upgrading the engineering
designs, aiming at generation-cost
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
reduction, in view of global development
of such technologies;
(b) whether the import of fuel (coal)
directly by National Thermal Power
Corporation (NTPC) rather than
channelizing  it through prevalent system
of import through State Trading
Corporation (STC), Minerals and Metals
Trading Corporation (MMTC) etc. would
be a cost-effective alternative;
(c) whether NTPC is thinking of
acquiring power plants in Europe,
Australia, etc. with good coal linkage;
and
(d) whether ownership of mines abroad
would be explored towards cost-cutting
measures?
New Mining Bill, 2011
†*8. SHRI RAMCHANDRA PRASAD
SINGH: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that draft of the
new Mining Bill, 2011 provides that the
coal companies would have to invest 26
per cent of their profits towards the
development of local areas;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and whether
any draft scheme for spending this money
has been prepared by the coal companies;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Schemes and programmes of the
Ministry
*9. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the Minister
of MINORITY AFFAIRS be pleased to
state the details of the schemes, plans and
programmes of the Ministry, the benefit of
which goes to non-minorities also?
Credit facilities for MSMEs
*10. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the problems being
faced by Micro, Small and Medium
Enterprises (MSMEs) in accessing credit;
(b) whether it is a fact that banks are
apprehensive of high risk perception and
are not prioritizing their loans to MSMEs;
(c) if so, to what extent Government's
Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme, Micro
Finance Programme and Performance and
Credit Rating Scheme, helps in overcoming
the above hurdles; and
(d) the credit flow to MSMEs during
the last five years, sector-wise and
year-wise?
Distribution of CFLs
*11. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has any plan
of distributing Compact Fluorescent Lamps
(CFLs) through the Public Distribution
System (PDS) so that all the ration card
holders can get CFLs at subsidised rate,
resulting reduction in power consumption;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Ombudsman for legal sector
*12. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister of
LAW AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is working on
a Bill that envisages an Ombudsman to
look into the complaints against lawyers
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

4
and a Legal Services Board that would
regulate law practices in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the role of Bar Councils
would be minimized with the passage of
the Bill; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Storage shortage problem of FCI
*13. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Food Corporation of
India (FCI) is facing severe storage
shortage owing to the increasing
procurement of wheat;
(b) whether the agencies involved in
procurement are going ahead with
temporary storage facilities, whereas
Government’s announcement to build new
godowns is still on paper; and
(c) how many godowns are proposed
to be built and how many of them would
come under Public-Private Partnership
(PPP) and by when?
Pending cases in Assam
*14. SHRI BHUBANESWAR KALITA:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of pending cases in all
the courts of Assam during last five years;
and
(b) the details of the steps taken to
expedite disposal of the pending cases?
SC directive on foodgrains distribution
*15. SHRI Y .S. CHOWDARY: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court has
issued any directive to release foodgrains
to prevent starvation deaths and
malnutrition;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken/proposed to be
taken by Government to implement the
directive?
Construction of godowns
*16. PROF. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the physical and
financial targets set for construction of
godowns during 2009-10 in respect of
North-Eastern States as well as other States;
(b) whether Government has achieved
the targets;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and the
measures taken to step up the construction
work;
(d) the quantum of foodgrains damaged
during 2008-09, 2009-10 and 2010-11; and
(e) the quantum of foodgrains still lying
in open?
Illegal mining in Aravali hills
†*17. SHRI PARVEZ HASHMI: Will
the Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that illegal mining
is going on in some places of Aravali hills
in Haryana and Rajasthan;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

5
(b) if so, the steps being taken to check
the said illegal mining;
(c) whether it is  a fact that inspite of
the Aravali hills being declared protected,
State Governments are unable to check this
illegal mining; and
(d) if so, whether Government is
considering to make some other law in this
regard and if so, the details thereof?
Illegal coal mining
*18. MS. MABEL REBELLO:  Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of good quality coal
illegally taken away from various coal
mines as rejects annually;
(b) the value thereof;
(c) the details for the last three years,
company-wise, tonnage-wise and value-
wise; and
(d) what measures the Ministry
proposes to take to stop illegal coal mining
altogether in all its mining companies?
Distribution of foodgrains
*19. SHRI. R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that, instead of
exporting rice, the Ministry is planning to
distribute excess foodgrains to BPL
families;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the proposed distribution
to BPL families is free of cost or on normal
rates?
Planning for reservoirs in Uttar
Pradesh
†*20. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that reservoirs/
ponds have been used for the purpose of
water harvesting in the country since
ancient times;
(b) whether it is also a fact that most of
these have become extinct due to neglect;
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(d) whether there is any plan to revamp
them; and
(e) if so, the details thereof, State-wise,
particularly with regard to Uttar Pradesh?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 26th July, 2011 Secretary-General.
Sravana 4, 1933 (Saka)

(Ministry-wise)
